text: Read-only hosting: a public view that pulls from git when someone opens it
description: Felix 2026-11-09: a read-only mode for hosting, e.g. a company makes its graph visible to everyone. It pulls updates from git on open, with checks debounced to ~3 s. Builds on hosting (af701cd6: anyone reads, accounts write), the 5-minute fast-forward pull (b008055a), opening a Git URL read-only (9ed9e7df) and the read-only UI (f32a74fd). 9beb3725 had left a hosted public viewer out of scope 'unless decided separately': this is that decision.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A public read-only instance is only acceptable if an anonymous visitor can read nothing beyond the graph and cannot exhaust the server; refuted if a re-audit after these fixes still finds a path to code, server files or unbounded work.

status.comment:
Asked Felix 2026-11-09 before building: (1) Is read-only mode a hosting option with no accounts or login at all, so changes arrive only via git? Or keep accounts and just add pull-on-open? (2) Serve from a Git URL as a throwaway clone (fetch + reset --hard, like openGitRepository), so it never gets stuck on uncommitted edits or diverged history? (3) Pull on open (page load / connection, debounced 3 s across viewers): does it replace the 5-minute timer, or keep a slow timer as well for long-open tabs? (4) Keep the MCP on a public instance (read-only), or turn it off? (5) OK to work on v7's main while another agent commits there?

Entry-point analysis (2026-11-09, from backend/src/auth/access.ts, trpc.ts, server.ts): a separate entry point adds no safety, because enforcement is already server-side on every call. Hosted mode (AIMPARENCY_HOSTED + AIMPARENCY_PROJECT) runs one tRPC middleware for every call, MCP included (the MCP is a tRPC client too). An anonymous viewer gets role 'read'; unlisted mutations need admin (closed by default); loop, watchdog, system, voice, market and spinOff are refused outright; agents are off unless AIMPARENCY_AGENTS. A separate UI build would only hide buttons; the API stays callable. Recommended instead: one flag (e.g. AIMPARENCY_READ_ONLY=true) that caps every viewer at 'read' whatever the token (no login, no accounts), forbids AIMPARENCY_AGENTS, and lets the UI drop its login button. Gaps to close for an anonymous public instance: the 'read mutations' project.buildSearchIndex (CPU cost, anyone can trigger it), activity.record and phase.setCursor; pull-on-open debounced 3 s (today only a 5-minute timer).
